title: Inquest into death
article: An inquest into the death of Albert William Prevost was scheduled to commence May 19 at the Port Hardy Law Courts.

Mr. Prevost was in medical distress while in Port Hardy RCMP custody Mar. 14, 2008. He was transported by ambulance to Port Hardy hospital and was later transported to Campbell River hospital where, despite medical treatment, he died on Mar. 23, 2008.
The inquest is scheduled for May 19 to 21, and will be heard by a judge and jury.
The jury will have the oportunity to make recommendations aimed at preventing deaths under similar circumstances in the future.
An inquest is a formal court proceeding that allows for public presentation of all evidence relating to a death, however a coroner's inquest does not rule on legal responsibility for a death.
